reviews.comment: The classes had a weird structure, and she didn't really teach; rather showed examples and assumed we'd know what to do. Despite this, the projects are easy, and all except 1 were group projects. If you can write decently, you'll be fine. Attendance isn't strict, but she'll get upset if you miss too many classes. Great feedback, but somewhat rude.

This instructor did not communicate assignments well and has failed to start class on time and she would mention important bits of information at the very end of class. And having my next class on campus, this was very difficult.

She was lowkey soo annoying. We did not learn ANYTHING helpful in class and she would just give us the assignments and expect us to know what to do. She is also very bad at communicating. We were supposed to have a final assignment during finals and she never gave it to us and hasn't graded anything in weeks.

I do not recommend taking her if you are trying to have a light schedule. She grades VERY harshly and can be very condescending with replies or comments about your grade. She blamed my essay to have AI in it but I only used it for grammar corrections...

This professor does not grade based on the rubric and grades based on whether she likes you or not. Her feedback is very unclear and often contradicts itself and when I asked her about it she couldn't give me a clear answer and couldn't connect it to the rubric. She also likes to trigger her students to make them "feel certain emotions".

Dr. LG was honestly pretty great! She was spunky and fun and made the class enjoyable. One critique I have is that she does not provide a rubric for some assignments, which made some of them hard to figure out and she uses uncommon words. Despite that, she is amazing and wants everyone to succeed! She is very accessible outside of class as well!
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Great teacher overall, worked well with her students and responded to emails quickly even when she had to leave for a few weeks. Very understanding and gives constant in-depth feedback for each assignment that was turned in. Would definitely recommend taking her, already recommended my friends to take her. Her lectures were also very interesting.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I genuinely enjoyed this class and she has to be the easiest english prof I've ever taken. She's so involved with her students that she is constantly giving feedback that I thought was extremely helpful! big paper assignments were broken up to small assignments to help the writing process which I enjoyed. She's amazing!! will be taking her for 210!

Do not, I repeat DO NOT take her class like in all honesty if I could give her a zero I would. None of the assignments have pleased her. She never answers emails. She doesn't teach and assumes you know everything. She gives unclear lectures, thus assignments are confusing. She makes ambiguous comments on your assignments, which confuses you more.
